responsibility: Implements the RISC-V post-expand optimization for functions compiled with `-msave-restore`. It pattern-matches the prologue and epilogue RTL sequences that call the out-of-line GPR save/restore stubs, verifies the function body does not actually require those libcalls except in restricted cases, and when possible rewrites the final call into a sibcall/tail call and removes the save/restore prologue-epilogue instructions, thereby cleaning up over-conservative save/restore decisions made earlier in expansion.
